result.summary:
Checked out feature/WF02-REQ422-20260929 (4117f3da). Host free memory checked per this run's memory-aware instructions: Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem showed FreePhysicalMemory=4228328 KB (~4.03 GB) of 33389048 KB total -- at the tight threshold -- so TEST_PARALLEL_N was set to 8 (half of 16 logical processors) rather than full nproc-derived parallelism.

Attempt 1 (TEST_PARALLEL_N=8): failed before any partition launched -- 'partition 3 ecto.create/ecto.migrate failed with exit 1' with a DBConnection.ConnectionError connection-pool timeout during the seeding+migrating phase. Retried per this run's procedure.

Attempt 2 (TEST_PARALLEL_N=8): 7 of 8 partitions completed; partition 6 crashed ~15s into its own test_helper.exs setup (Letflow.Test.TenantTemplate.ensure_template!/0 compiling the tenant migration module) with a second, independent DBConnection.ConnectionError (connection checkout timed out after 15000ms) -- zero tests executed in that partition, never reaching ExUnit's Result:/Failed: lines. Combined result across the 7 completed partitions: 4422 tests, 6 properties, 1 failures (4427/4428 passed); partition 6's own ~600-700 tests were never executed. Per this run's explicit instruction to STOP after a second resource-contention failure rather than retry a third time blindly, no further attempt was made this step.

The one real failure (partition 1): test/docs/requirement_status_invariants_test.exs's A4b case, caused by docs/status/requirement_status.v23.yaml's REQ-422 'started' entry (line 1068, an uncommitted working-tree edit from this run's own Step 00) not matching the required [:req, :event, :agent, :at, :note] shape -- missing 'agent', 'run' where 'note' is expected, extra 'summary' field. Structurally attributed (not pre-existing, not apps/mobile/'s fault): this file is a working-tree edit made during this very run, and the causal mechanism (exact missing/misnamed/extra fields at the flagged entry_line) is directly demonstrated, not inferred. Routed to ORCH/DOC-UPDATER to correct the bookkeeping entry's shape -- not fixed here (TEST-RUNNER does not own docs/status/*).

apps/mobile/ itself: flutter analyze -> 'No issues found! (ran in 15.3s)'. flutter test -> 86/86 passed ('All tests passed!'), re-run fresh in this step rather than cited from an earlier step's quote.

Full real output and per-partition breakdown recorded in test/reports/report-20260929-WF02-REQ422-20260929.yaml.
